from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,struct,datetime,os,time,copy
p=Path('/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar/docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-05/short-groom-artist-source')
start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc); clock=time.monotonic()
def read(n): return json.loads((p/n).read_text())
def sha(q): return hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def verify(row):
 q=Path(row['path']); assert q.stat().st_size==row['bytes'] and sha(q)==row['sha256'],str(q)
rows=0
for n in ['SOURCE-RECEIPT.json','DATA-RECEIPT.json','ROOT-NATIVE-ADMISSION.json']:
 r=read(n)
 for row in r['inputs']: verify(row); rows+=1
 rresult=r.get('result')
 if rresult: verify(rresult);rows+=1
m=read('export/mesh.json'); e=read('export/expected.json')
r=read('NATIVE.READY.json'); f=read('NATIVE.FINISHED.json')
for n,o in [('NATIVE.READY',r),('NATIVE.FINISHED',f)]:
 lines=(p/(n+'.dom.txt')).read_text().splitlines()
 dom=json.loads(json.loads(lines[-1].removeprefix('- generic: ')))
 assert dom==o['record']; assert len(lines)==13
a=r['record']; b=f['record']
assert a['meshSha']==e['meshSha']==sha(p/'export/mesh.json')
pos=struct.pack('<'+'f'*(3*len(m['positions'])),*(c for v in m['positions'] for c in v))
assert a['positionSha']==e['positionSha']==hashlib.sha256(pos).hexdigest()
assert len(a['parts'])==len(e['parts'])==len(m['parts'])==22
for actual,exp,part in zip(a['parts'],e['parts'],m['parts']):
 indices=[i for fid in part['face_ids'] for i in m['triangles'][fid]]
 digest=hashlib.sha256(struct.pack('<'+'I'*len(indices),*indices)).hexdigest()
 assert actual['id']==exp['id']==part['id']
 assert actual['kind']==part['kind'] and actual['color']==part['color']
 assert actual['vertices']==exp['vertices']==len(part['vertex_ids'])
 assert actual['triangles']==exp['triangles']==len(part['face_ids'])
 assert actual['indexCount']==len(indices) and actual['indexSha']==exp['indexSha']==digest
 assert actual['positionSha']==a['positionSha']
assert a['vertices']==len(m['positions'])==9580 and a['triangles']==len(m['triangles'])==19072
assert a['roots']==len(m['roots'])==16 and a['scalpFaces']==len(m['scalp']['head_face_ids'])==724
assert a['bounds']==e['bounds']
aa=copy.deepcopy(a);bb=copy.deepcopy(b);aa.pop('lifetime');bb.pop('lifetime');assert aa==bb
assert a['draws']==b['draws']==4 and a['error'] is None and b['error'] is None
names=[];colors=set()
for part in m['parts']:
 if part['color'] not in colors: names.append('material '+part['color']); colors.add(part['color'])
 names.append('geometry '+part['id'])
names.append('renderer')
life=b['lifetime'];assert a['lifetime']=={'closed':False,'reason':None,'attempts':[]}
assert life['closed'] and life['reason']=='Finish button'
assert [x['name'] for x in life['attempts']]==names and len(names)==27 and all(x['error'] is None for x in life['attempts'])
assert r['overflow']==0 and r['viewport']['width']==1280 and r['viewport']['height']==720 and r['viewport']['dpr']==2
assert a['stage']==[1100,1100]
names_views=['front','profile','rear','top']
deltas=[[0,0,5],[5,0,0],[0,0,-5],[0,5,0]]
vps=[[0,550,550,550],[550,550,550,550],[0,0,550,550],[550,0,550,550]]
maxima=[]
for k,v in enumerate(a['views']):
 assert v['name']==names_views[k] and v['viewport']==vps[k]
 assert v['near']==.1 and v['far']==12
 assert all(abs(v['position'][j]-v['target'][j]-deltas[k][j])<1e-15 for j in range(3))
 assert v['up']==([0,0,-1] if k==3 else [0,1,0])
 w=v['matrixWorld'];proj=v['projectionMatrix'];maxi=[0.,0.,0.]
 for point in m['positions']:
  d=[point[j]-w[12+j] for j in range(3)]
  cam=[sum(w[4*j+i]*d[i] for i in range(3)) for j in range(3)]+[1.]
  clip=[sum(proj[4*j+i]*cam[j] for j in range(4)) for i in range(4)]
  ndc=[clip[j]/clip[3] for j in range(3)]
  maxi=[max(maxi[j],abs(ndc[j])) for j in range(3)]
 assert maxi[0]<1 and maxi[1]<1 and maxi[2]<1
 maxima.append({'view':v['name'],'max_abs_ndc':maxi})
opened=read('NATIVE.OPEN.json');cap=read('NATIVE.CAPTURE.json');closed=read('NATIVE.CLOSED.json')
def dt(t):return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(t.replace('Z','+00:00'))
times=[read('ROOT-NATIVE-ADMISSION.json')['admitted_utc'],opened['opened_utc'],r['observed_utc'],read('ROOT-NATIVE-GATE.json')['verified_utc'],cap['started_utc'],cap['returned_utc'],f['observed_utc'],closed['close_started_utc'],closed['closed_readback_utc']]
assert [dt(t) for t in times]==sorted(dt(t) for t in times)
assert all(x['tab_id']=='45' for x in [opened,r,cap,f,closed])
assert opened['before']==[] and closed['after']==[] and closed['only_owned_closed']
assert not opened['viewport_override'] and not cap['viewport_override'] and not closed['viewport_override']
assert cap['sole_original'] and cap['fullPage'] and not cap['retake'] and not cap['crop']
assert Path(cap['path'])==p/'four-view-first.jpg' and (p/'four-view-first.jpg').stat().st_size==cap['bytes']==120265
assert sha(p/'four-view-first.jpg')=='5859c4a1341138989de77c8c80d26ff0630ca13807819840a2a91e3d008546dd'
print(json.dumps({'pid':os.getpid(),'started_utc':start.isoformat(),'ended_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-clock,'receipt_rows_verified':rows,'DOM_records_equal':True,'all22_part_metadata_and_actual_buffer_hashes_match':True,'ready_finished_only_lifetime_changed':True,'source_resource_order':names,'all27_disposal_returns_no_reported_error':True,'all4_actual_saved_camera_vertex_frames':maxima,'admission_native_clock_order':times,'known_tab_closed_before_after_empty':True,'limits':'Saved metadata/byte/rigid-matrix comparison only; no renderer/helper import/producer replay or continuous overlap/attachment/GPU retirement/appearance proof'},indent=2))
